description: Fetch Wikipedia's daily aggregation for a given UTC date (default today): featured article, most-read articles with view counts, on-this-day historical events, and picture of the day. Missing fields are omitted. Works across language editions.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today's UTC date.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Wikipedia language edition code (e.g. zh, en, ja). Defaults to zh.
